acceptance_criteria.statement: Measured chord equals predicted geodesic distance for every marker pair
acceptance_criteria.test: E_n = |m - p| / U <= 1 with U = k u_pair, k = 2, u_pair = 0.0283 mm (camera)

acceptance_criteria.statement: Offset-path separation is constant (lateral) and linear in s (heading)
acceptance_criteria.test: slope of heading-offset separation equals the heading difference measured at the start (CMM) within 2 sigma of the regression slope

procedure.action: Soak the specimen and its holder for 4 h at 20 +/- 1 C; log air and part temperature every 10 min.
outputs: environment log with an explicit UTC offset

procedure.action: Check the instruments before the acquisition: the camera images SB-1000; the tracker measures the SB-1000 end points with its SMR; the CMM probes GS-25.4 at 25 points. Retain every check.
procedure.check: each artifact reading lies within 2 U of its certificate value, U from the declared instrument uncertainty; otherwise stop and recalibrate

procedure.action: Locate the specimen in FX-321 (3-2-1 nest); clamp; probe datum A (3 points), B (2 points) and C (1 point) with the CMM and build the PART frame (datum_frame_321).
Measure the four datum targets of FX-321 (a 1.5 in SMR seated on each) with the tracker to register FIXTURE in WORLD (frame chain).
outputs: WORLD -> FIXTURE transform and its covariance

procedure.action: Measure all 25 coded markers with the camera (12 stations, SB-1000 and the FX-321 datum targets in every image set) and probe their centres with the CMM; export the camera coordinates as the photogrammetry capture.
Repeat steps 3 and 5 twice more, removing the specimen from FX-321 and re-seating it between repeats (replicates of the marker measurement).
outputs: two further replicates (replicates of the marker measurement)

procedure.action: Seat the start jig JIG-START-01 against datums B and C with the insert of tape N0; lay tape N0 from its slot without in-plane steering (a robot may carry the tape head but must not steer it; never draw a path traced from the model); remove the jig. No other tape is on the specimen.
outputs: tape N0: identity and laying time

procedure.action: Probe the centreline of tape N0 with the CMM at s = 0 and s = 20 mm; export the points as rows N0-S0 and N0-S20 of the cmm capture.
outputs: cmm capture rows N0-S0 and N0-S20 (ciw.lab-mfg-target-capture.v1)

procedure.action: Place 6 mm coded targets on the centreline of tape N0 every 30 mm from s = 0 to 240 mm.
Measure the targets on tape N0 with the camera, with SB-1000 and the FX-321 datum targets (coded adapters) in every image set; retain their coordinates (no task reads them yet).
Repeat steps 3, 8 and 10 twice more, removing the specimen from FX-321 and re-seating it between repeats (replicates of tape N0; the tape and its targets stay in place).
outputs: two further replicates (replicates of tape N0; the tape and its targets stay in place)

procedure.action: Remove the targets and tape N0.

Seat the start jig JIG-START-01 against datums B and C with the insert of tape L2; lay tape L2 from its slot without in-plane steering (a robot may carry the tape head but must not steer it; never draw a path traced from the model); remove the jig. No other tape is on the specimen.
outputs: tape L2: identity and laying time

procedure.action: Probe the centreline of tape L2 with the CMM at s = 0 and s = 20 mm; export the points as rows L2-S0 and L2-S20 of the cmm capture.
outputs: cmm capture rows L2-S0 and L2-S20 (ciw.lab-mfg-target-capture.v1)

procedure.action: Place 6 mm coded targets on the centreline of tape L2 every 30 mm from s = 0 to 240 mm.
Measure the targets on tape L2 with the camera, with SB-1000 and the FX-321 datum targets (coded adapters) in every image set; retain their coordinates (no task reads them yet).
Repeat steps 3, 14 and 16 twice more, removing the specimen from FX-321 and re-seating it between repeats (replicates of tape L2; the tape and its targets stay in place).
outputs: two further replicates (replicates of tape L2; the tape and its targets stay in place)

procedure.action: Remove the targets and tape L2.

Seat the start jig JIG-START-01 against datums B and C with the insert of tape H5; lay tape H5 from its slot without in-plane steering (a robot may carry the tape head but must not steer it; never draw a path traced from the model); remove the jig. No other tape is on the specimen.
outputs: tape H5: identity and laying time

procedure.action: Probe the centreline of tape H5 with the CMM at s = 0 and s = 20 mm; export the points as rows H5-S0 and H5-S20 of the cmm capture.
outputs: cmm capture rows H5-S0 and H5-S20 (ciw.lab-mfg-target-capture.v1)

procedure.action: Place 6 mm coded targets on the centreline of tape H5 every 30 mm from s = 0 to 240 mm.
Measure the targets on tape H5 with the camera, with SB-1000 and the FX-321 datum targets (coded adapters) in every image set; retain their coordinates (no task reads them yet).
Repeat steps 3, 20 and 22 twice more, removing the specimen from FX-321 and re-seating it between repeats (replicates of tape H5; the tape and its targets stay in place).
outputs: two further replicates (replicates of tape H5; the tape and its targets stay in place)

procedure.action: Remove the targets and tape H5.
Check the instruments after the acquisition: the camera images SB-1000; the tracker measures the SB-1000 end points with its SMR; the CMM probes GS-25.4 at 25 points. Retain every check.
procedure.check: each artifact reading lies within 2 U of its certificate value, U from the declared instrument uncertainty; otherwise stop and recalibrate

procedure.action: Retain every raw file, replicate and instrument check with its T139 retention record (ciw.lab-measurement-retention.v1).
outputs: retained raw data and retention records

purpose: Establish the measurement chain on a specimen where chord, geodesic and Jacobi predictions are trivial, so any residual belongs to the instruments, frames or procedure.

required_raw_data: raw camera images (lossless) with exposure metadata and SHA-256 digests
tracker/CMM native point files with instrument serial and firmware
calibration certificates of scale bars, gauge sphere and step gauge (digest and validity window)
frame-chain transforms with covariances as computed at the time of measurement

operator, fixture and specimen identities; clock source and synchronization method

tape_layout.rules: tapes on the specimen together: centrelines at least a tape width plus a target diameter apart; slots used in one laying: at least one slot width apart; every tape centreline clears each specimen marker and datum probe point by half the wider of tape and target plus half a marker (manufacturing_records._tape_layout, on the predicted centrelines)
tape_layout.sequence: one tape on the specimen at a time: seat the start jig with that tape's insert, lay the tape, remove the jig, measure the tape and its targets (with re-seated replicates) and remove them before the next tape is laid; every tape is measured in the PART frame of the specimen's own datums
